title: Pure Altergeist
summary: Altergeist cards only, with generic staples. Altergeist is a Trap control deck that recycles its own cards. Altergeist Marionetter Sets an Altergeist Trap from the Deck. Multifaker summons itself whenever you activate a Trap and brings another Altergeist from the Deck, and Silquitous bounces their card by bouncing one of yours. Altergeist Protocol makes your Altergeist effects unnegatable and negates a monster effect by sending one of your cards. The 2023 cards lead. Altergeist Malwisp summons itself when searched and revives an Altergeist. Peritrator mills an Altergeist card when it leaves the field. Altergeist Adminia Sets a Trap from the Deck and steals a monster. Altergeist Revitalization revives a Link Monster and grants a Normal Summon. Multifaker limits you to Altergeist summons that turn, so the Extra Deck is mostly Altergeist.
